description: Header file defining the ContainerAdministrator class for managing process containers, including singleton access, creation, retrieval, and registration of container producers.

classes.name: ContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages process container instances, registration of producers, and container creation and retrieval.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the container administrator with a configuration string.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a container of specified type with given arguments.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Retrieves a container by type and ID, with search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all containers.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Registers a new container producer for a specific container type.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a container producer for a specific container type.
